text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Alert — PagerDuty page fired for service `billing-worker` -> routed to `platform-oncall` (3 pages, no ack)

marta: Wait that's wrong, billing-worker should route to billing-oncall. Are we leaking pages to platform?

devin: I pushed a routing rule update at 07:12 that merged service-tag normalization into the routing map. I was careful but... might have clobbered the `service.team` mapping.

lee: Confirming — seeing a spike in pages routed to platform-oncall in PD logs. This is causing escalation storms there. Need immediate mitigation.

sam: Temporarily silencing the PagerDuty service `platform-oncall` for 10m to stop the fanout. Will also add a one-off PD maintenance window.

kelsey: Copying for customer-impact: any errors hitting billing customers? Metric shows increased 503s hitting billing write endpoints since 07:10.

marta: @sam do not silence for too long — if billing is actually degraded we need owners alerted. Short window only.

sam: Agreed. Silence set for 10m. Adding a note: "temporary silencing due to misrouted pages; investigating routing rule change"

devin: Reverting the routing change now. Patch: `git show HEAD~1:infra/pagerduty/routing.yml` -> I rolled back the normalization. PD binding should follow.

devin: PD API call I'm using:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://api.pagerduty.com/services/P123456" \
  -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"service": {"escalation_policy": "P-PLATFORM-ESCPOL", "teams": ["T-billing"]}}'
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incident/pd-routing-misbind — steps: validate service bindings, revert last deploy, confirm PD mappings, notify customers.

lee: @devin once PD bindings update, please send a manual page to billing-oncall as a smoke test.

devin: Done — manual page to `billing-oncall` sent. Acked by `kelsey`.

kelsey: Acked and taking lead on customer comms. Drafting status: "We briefly misrouted alerting due to an internal routing config change; investigating impact to billing writes; no confirmed data loss yet."

marta: Good. After the rollback we'll run a replay of the last 30m of alerts through a staging routing map to confirm no other services affected.

sam: Removing silence in 2m. PD bindings show platform-oncall pages stopped and billing-oncall receiving the right alerts now.

kelsey: Customer impact: ~12 customers saw transient 503s, retry success within 30s for most. Filing P1? I'd say P2 since no customer data lost.

lee: Agree P2. We'll open a short postmortem and document the routing change checklist.

devin: Sorry folks. Adding extra test to CI to catch routing mapping regressions. PR incoming.

marta: Thanks. Closing thread once postmortem link is posted.
